order_complete_msg: We’ve sent you a confirmation email shortly with the details of your order, along with everything you need to know about your purchase.
order_free_msg: Your order has been placed successfully. No payment required.
order_locked_msg: This invoice is locked, typically because a charge attempt is in progress. Locking prevents the invoice from being charged twice.
order_not_found_msg: Unfortunately, we were unable to find your order. Please click the button below to view your orders.
order_partial_payment_msg: We've received {paid_amount}. Please continue with payment to complete your order.
order_payment_failed_msg: We were unable to process your payment for this order. Please click below to go to your invoice where you can retry your payment.
order_pending_msg: Any overpayments will be added as account credit.
order_placed_msg: Your order has been confirmed. Please continue with payment to complete your purchase.
payment_failed_banner: Your payment attempt was unsuccessful - please try again.
payment_partial_msg: You have {paid_amount} remaining. Please complete your payment to finish your order.
payment_retry: Payment for this order is still due in full
payment_retry_msg: Unfortunately, your previous payment attempt was unsuccessful - this can be for a number of reasons. Please try again using an alternative method.
